title: 22 March 1961: Live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
content:
The Beatles’ 13th known Cavern Club performance took place on this day.

Although the precise number of their Cavern performances is not known, The Beatles played at least 155 lunchtime and 125 evening shows. Their final performance at the underground venue took place on 3 August 1963.

This was their 12th lunchtime performance at the Cavern. The previous night had seen The Beatles’ first evening show at the venue.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024
